programme.title: Jako mi je stalo, film
programme.desc: Marla Grayson vrlo je uspješna skrbnica koja vrlo vješto zakonom manipulira u svoju korist i na štetu svojih klijenata, živeći luksuzni život na njihov račun. U trenutku kada odabere svoju sljedeću žrtvu, naizgled časnu, staru damu, prekasno shvati da izgled može itekako zavarati. Navukavši bijes ruske mafije, Marla mora iskoristiti svaku trunku svojeg šarma i nemilosrdne lukavosti da preživi.

programme.title: Moja stara gospođa, film
programme.desc: Njujorčanin Mathias (Kevin Kline) putuje u Pariz nakon što je saznao da je naslijedio prostrani stan od svog otuđenog oca. Mathias se nada da će jednostavno unovčiti svoje novo vlasništvo te se vratiti kući, no njegov plan naiđe na zapreku kad otkrije da postarija Mathilde (Maggie Smith) i njezina kći (Kristin Scott Thomas) žive u njegovu stanu te nemaju namjeru, ni pravno provediv razlog, napustiti ga. Stan je, kako saznaje, ono što Francuzi zovu „viager, koji se, u skladu sa stoljetnom tradicijom, ne može vratiti u njegov posjed sve dok sadašnji stanar ne umre. Dok pokušava prodati svoj ugovor te čak pribjegne i ucjeni kako bi zaradio od propalog posla, Mathias otkriva više o Mathilde i svom ocu nego što je namjeravao.

programme.title: Mid90s, film
programme.desc: Ovaj film prati tinejdžera po imenu Stevie dok odrasta u Los Angelesu. Muči se sa svojom obitelji, svojom samohranom majkom i svojim nasilnim starijim bratom, a i u školi, gdje ga njegovi bogatiji prijatelji previđaju. Kad se Stevie sprijatelji s ekipom skejtera, nauči teške lekcije o klasi, rasi i privilegiji.

programme.title: Tijelo, film
programme.desc: Crnohumorna i uvrnuta radnja TIJELA odvija se jedne nezaboravne Badnje večeri i prati tri studentice čija provala pođe po zlu. Kad se odšuljaju u osamljenu vilu na zabavu, djevojke se suočavaju s teškim izborima nakon što neočekivano susretnu čuvara imanja. Nakon slučajne nesreće djevojke se upletu u hičkokovsku noćnu moru punu napetosti, sumnje, prijevare i ubojstva, gdje nikomu ne treba vjerovati, a novi obrat leži iza svakog ugla.

programme.title: Lov na Marsupilamija, film
programme.desc: Kad reporter Dan Geraldo (Alain Chabat) dođe u Palombiju u lov na vijest, nije ni očekivao da će imati neočekivano otkriće… Sa svojim dosjetljivim mjesnim vodičem Pablitom (Jamel Debbouze), Dan doživljava iznenađenje za iznenađenjem u tijeku ove uzbudljive pustolovine koja mu pruža mogućnost da svijetu donese spektakularne vijesti: Marsupilami, mitska i nestašna životinja, doista postoji! I vi ćete povjerovati u dlakave repove!

programme.title: Moja čudovišna obitelj, film
programme.desc: „Moja čudovišna obitelj" je adaptacija istoimenog bestselera Emmyjem ovjenčanoga autora Davida Safiera ("Berlin, Berlin"), koji je preveden na 18 jezika i objavljen u preko 40 zemalja. Obitelj Wishbone je daleko od sretne obitelji. Mama Emma vlasnica je knjižare koja je u velikim dugovima. Tata Frank je ozbiljno preopterećen poslom i trpi svakodnevnu torturu svog šefa, kćer Fay je samosvjesna tinejdžerica zaokupljena prvom srednjoškolskom simpatijom, a genijalca Maxa maltretiraju vršnjaci u školi. I tu nije kraj. Na maskenbalu zla vještica Baba Yaga pretvara ih sve u čudovišta! Ova čudovišna obitelj mora natjeravati vješticu po cijelom svijetu kako bi skinuli prokletstvo. Tijekom ove avanture obitelj Wishbone upada u nevolje s pravim čudovištima te samim grofom Drakulom koji iskazuje Emmi svoju besmrtnu ljubav. U ovom slučaju, avantura života i put do obiteljske sreće otežan je zamkama i oštrim zavojima, odnosno oštrim zubima...

programme.title: Dolina bogova, film
programme.desc: Film spaja tri zasebne radnje kako bi stvorila epsku fantastičnu priču. Razvedeni pisac John Ecas (Josh Hartnett) angažiran je kako bi napisao biografiju najbogatijeg čovjeka na svijetu, povučenog Wesa Taurosa (John Malkovich). John ne zna da je zemlja kojom korača sveta i da je u sporu između industrijalca bogataša Wesa Taurosa (John Malkovich), koji zemlju želi minirati zbog urana, i borbenog lokalnog indijanskog plemena Navajo. Taurosovi postupci otkrivaju bića iz Navajo legendi za koje se smatralo da nisu ništa više od mita. Dok se tri strane sukobljavaju, predodžbe o tome što je doista vrijedno dolaze u fokus kad bogovi starih ratuju protiv želja modernog čovjeka.

programme.title: Rupa straha, film
programme.desc: Redatelj Joe Dante donosi nam 3D pustolovinu koja istražuje strahove i tajne zakopane u umovima klinaca. Kada se dosele u novu četvrt, braća Dane i Lucas i njihova susjeda Julie otkrivaju rupu bez dna u podrumu njihove kuće. Uviđaju da otkrivanje rupe oslobađa zlo. S čudnim sjenama koje vrebaju iza svakog ugla i noćnim morama koje se ostvaruju, primorani su suočiti se sa svojim najvećim strahovima kako bi dokrajčili misterij rupe straha.

programme.title: Šegrt Hlapić, film
programme.desc: "Šegrt Hlapić" raskošno je snimljen pustolovni film za cijelu obitelj prema glasovitom romanu Ivane Brlić Mažuranić o plemenitom i hrabrom dječaku Hlapiću koji bježeći od okrutnoga majstora putuje svijetom u potrazi za boljim životom. Pridružuje mu se djevojčica Gita koja traži roditelje. Uz mnogo dobrote i mudrosti svladavaju sve prepreke i ostvaraju svoj konačan cilj i pronalaze pravi dom. Film je na 61. pulskom filmskom festivalu osvojio nagradu publike, Zlatna vrata Pule.

programme.title: Šegrt Hlapić, film

programme.title: Vrata ratnika, film
programme.desc: Jack Bronson (Uriah Shelton) dijelom živi u virtualnom svijetu pa svaki svoj slobodan trenutak pobjegne u svijet računalnih igrica kao Crni vitez. No jednoga mu dana g. Chang, prodavač antikviteta, ponudi tajanstvenu kinesku škrinju, koja je zapravo čarobni portal u očaravajući svijet drevne Kine. Jedne se večeri u njegovoj sobi pojavi ratnik Zhao (Mark Chao) i da mu zadatak da čuva kraljevnu Sulin (Ni Ni), a Jack ubrzo padne na šarm mlade žene. Kad Sulin otmu i prebace je u drevnu Kinu, Jack uskoči u škrinju za njom i krene potjera. U Kini se udruži sa Zhaom. Uz pomoć čarobnjaka Wua (Francis Ng), kreću na putovanje ovim spektakularnim područjem, punim zlikovaca i prepreka kako bi spasili Sulin od Aruna (Dave Bautista), zlog i nasilnog ratničkog vođe, koji se planira oženiti kraljevnom i zavladati njezinim kraljevstvom te je ubiti prve bračne noći. Bojažljivi Jack mora se suočiti sa svojim strahovima, osvojiti nepoznati svemir, postati uspješan ratnik te spasiti kraljevnu i njezino kraljevstvo. Samo će se tada moći vratiti kući i suočiti se s izazovima svog suvremenog svijeta.

programme.title: Naslijeđeno zlo, film
programme.desc: Svaka obitelj ima svoje tajne. Neke vode ravno u pakao.Nakon smrti Ellen Graham, njezina obitelj počinje razotkrivati zastrašujuće tajne o svome podrijetlu. Što više otkrivaju, to više nastoje izbjeći zlokobnu sudbinu koju su naslijedili.

programme.title: Memento, film
programme.desc: Leonard (G. Pearce) je čovjek bez dugotrajnog sjećanja, ima samo kratkotrajno. Zahvaljujući složenome sustavu podsjetnika rasutih po polaroid fotografijama, papirićima, pa čak i tetovažama na tijelu, zna da je primivši udarac u glavu u borbi sa silovateljem i ubojicom voljene žene zauvijek gurnut u sadašnjost. Iz prošlosti do njega neprestano dopiru kratki bljeskovi lica i događaja koje ne može povezati. Sve što čini, a očito je da traži ubojicu u želji da mu se osveti, dvojbeno je i vjerojatno pogrešno. Ne postoji nijedna čvrsta točka za koju bi se uhvatio, a odustajanje od obračuna s neuhvatljivim sjenama prošlosti učinilo bi upitnim i njegovu budućnost. Je li se pretvorio u smrtonosno oružje kojim upravljaju drugi? Ne otvara li osveta, kojom pokušava staviti točku na ono što je izgubio, novi krug zločina? Scenarist i redatelj Christopher Nolan u svojoj inačici obrade poznatoga i često rabljenog motiva Kaspara Hausera, te svojevrsnom remakeu glasovite norveške "Insomnie", uspješno gradi složenu narativnu strukturu u kojoj svoga junaka neprestanim nizanjem kratkotrajnih i akcelerirajućih flash-backova gura u sve nove i nove zavijutke labirinta koji ga je okružio. Pritom se i sam upušta u neizvjesnu pustolovinu beskrajnoga meandriranja koju svladava neočekivano uspješno i efektno. Poznavatelje djela ovoga nesvakidašnjega filmaša, koji je na sebe pozornost skrenuo već svojim ranim kratkim filmovima snimljenim osam i šesnaestmilimetarskom kamerom (Tarantella), a status velike nade potvrdio i prvim dugometražnim, crno-bijelim projektom, "Following", nagrađenim brojnim festivalskim priznanjima (Rotterdam, Slamdance, Hong Kong), takvim ishodom nije nimalo iznenadio. Riječ je o nadarenome i iznimno obrazovanom autoru velike imaginacije, koji suvereno vlada svim elementima zanata. Izvrsnoga suradnika imao je i u Guyu Pearceu (L. A. povjerljivo), Australcu engleskoga podrijetla, koji je suvereno odigrao glavnu ulogu. Dobru epizodnu ulogu ostvarila je i Carrie-Anne Moss, gledateljima poznata iz uspješnica poput "Matrixa" i "Čokolade".

Scenarist i redatelj Christopher Nolan u svojoj inačici obrade poznatoga i često rabljenog motiva Kaspara Hausera, te svojevrsnom remakeu glasovite norveške "Insomnie", uspješno gradi složenu narativnu strukturu u kojoj svoga junaka neprestanim nizanjem kratkotrajnih i akcelerirajućih flash-backova gura u sve nove i nove zavijutke labirinta koji ga je okružio. Pritom se i sam upušta u neizvjesnu pustolovinu beskrajnoga meandriranja koju svladava neočekivano uspješno i efektno. Poznavatelje djela ovoga nesvakidašnjega filmaša, koji je na sebe pozornost skrenuo već svojim ranim kratkim filmovima snimljenim osam i šesnaestmilimetarskom kamerom (Tarantella), a status velike nade potvrdio i prvim dugometražnim, crno-bijelim projektom, "Following", nagrađenim brojnim festivalskim priznanjima (Rotterdam, Slamdance, Hong Kong), takvim ishodom nije nimalo iznenadio. Riječ je o nadarenome i iznimno obrazovanom autoru velike imaginacije, koji suvereno vlada svim elementima zanata. Izvrsnoga suradnika imao je i u Guyu Pearceu (L. A. povjerljivo), Australcu engleskoga podrijetla, koji je suvereno odigrao glavnu ulogu. Dobru epizodnu ulogu ostvarila je i Carrie-Anne Moss, gledateljima poznata iz uspješnica poput "Matrixa" i "Čokolade".

programme.title: Gost, film
programme.desc: Radnja ovog napetog horora prati veselu ekipu koja se preko čuvenog Zoom-a redovito čuje i razmjenjuje iskustva za vrijeme pandemije koronavirusa. Dugogodišnje prijateljice tako jednom prilikom dogovaraju konferencijski poziv s vidovnjakinjom, jer kako drugačije razdrmati monotoni karantenski život u kojem je jedina zabava i druženje s prijateljima zapravo razgovor putem konferencijskog poziva. Naravno, kad djevojke shvate da se još neko priključio njihovom Zoom pozivu, već je prekasno.

programme.title: Pahuljica, film
programme.desc: Nakon ekonomskog i društvenog kolapsa, u bliskoj budućnosti na ulicama Berlina vlada anarhija. Odvažni izopćenici TAN (35) i JAVID (33) imaju još jedan cilj u svojim životima: naći WINTERA (45), vođu podzemne fašističke organizacije odgovorne za umorstva njihovih obitelji. No lov na Wintera neočekivano se promijeni kad se Tan zavadi s kuharom zbog ukusa njegova kebaba i to dovede do pucnjave u kojoj ubiju ELIANINE (25) roditelje. Eliana potom unajmi strašne lovce na glave da ubiju Tana i Javida koji sada nisu ni svjesni da su postali metama zbog osobne osvete. Dok ne pronađu tajanstveni scenarij 'Pahuljica'…

programme.title: Šegrt Hlapić, film
programme.desc: "Šegrt Hlapić" raskošno je snimljen pustolovni film za cijelu obitelj prema glasovitom romanu Ivane Brlić Mažuranić o plemenitom i hrabrom dječaku Hlapiću koji bježeći od okrutnoga majstora putuje svijetom u potrazi za boljim životom. Pridružuje mu se djevojčica Gita koja traži roditelje. Uz mnogo dobrote i mudrosti svladavaju sve prepreke i ostvaraju svoj konačan cilj i pronalaze pravi dom. Film je na 61. pulskom filmskom festivalu osvojio nagradu publike, Zlatna vrata Pule.

programme.title: Moja čudovišna obitelj 2, film
programme.desc: Godinu dana nakon njihove čudovišne avanture, obitelj Wishbone ponovno živi svojim normalnim, ljudskim životima, koji su ispunjeni svim uobičajenim svađama, stresovima i svakodnevnim ludilom koje obiteljski život nosi. Iznenadni susret s Milom Starr označava početak nove avanture zbog koje svi njihovi 'normalni' problemi nestaju. Kako bi oslobodili Babu Jagu i Renfielda iz kandži Lovca na čudovišta, obitelj Wishbone se ponovno pretvara u vampira, Frankensteinovo čudovište, mumiju i vukodlaka. Zajedno sa svoja tri kućna ljubimca, naša obitelj ponovno proputuje cijeli svijet kako bi spasila svoje prijatelje, stekla nova čudovišna poznanstva i konačno shvatila da 'Nitko nije savršen' - i kako čak i oni s manama mogu pronaći sreću.

programme.title: Vrata ratnika, film
programme.desc: Jack Bronson (Uriah Shelton) dijelom živi u virtualnom svijetu pa svaki svoj slobodan trenutak pobjegne u svijet računalnih igrica kao Crni vitez. No jednoga mu dana g. Chang, prodavač antikviteta, ponudi tajanstvenu kinesku škrinju, koja je zapravo čarobni portal u očaravajući svijet drevne Kine. Jedne se večeri u njegovoj sobi pojavi ratnik Zhao (Mark Chao) i da mu zadatak da čuva kraljevnu Sulin (Ni Ni), a Jack ubrzo padne na šarm mlade žene. Kad Sulin otmu i prebace je u drevnu Kinu, Jack uskoči u škrinju za njom i krene potjera. U Kini se udruži sa Zhaom. Uz pomoć čarobnjaka Wua (Francis Ng), kreću na putovanje ovim spektakularnim područjem, punim zlikovaca i prepreka kako bi spasili Sulin od Aruna (Dave Bautista), zlog i nasilnog ratničkog vođe, koji se planira oženiti kraljevnom i zavladati njezinim kraljevstvom te je ubiti prve bračne noći. Bojažljivi Jack mora se suočiti sa svojim strahovima, osvojiti nepoznati svemir, postati uspješan ratnik te spasiti kraljevnu i njezino kraljevstvo. Samo će se tada moći vratiti kući i suočiti se s izazovima svog suvremenog svijeta.

programme.title: Mary i Max, film
programme.desc: Animirani film. Ona je osmogodišnja Mary iz predgrađa Melbournea, jedino dijete majke koja pije i rastrojenog oca. Nema prijatelja. On je Max Horowitz, muškarac prekomjerne težine s Aspergerovim sindromom i živi sam u New Yorku. Mary je našla njegovo ime u telefonskom imeniku i napisala mu pismo, uz koje je stavila čokoladicu. On je uzvratio pismom i čokoladom. Tako je počelo dvadesetogodišnje dopisivanje i prijateljstvo... Film je osvojio brojne australske nagrade, kao i međunarodne (Kristalnog medvjeda 2009. u Berlinu).

programme.title: Ljubavnici, film
programme.desc: Veliki koraljni greben, 2020. g. Nakon opasnog urona kako bi spasio svoju ženu Lauru koja je zaglavila dok je istraživala olupinu britanskog kolonijalnog broda, Jay Fennel, privlačan morski arheolog leži u bostonskoj bolnici, bez ikakve moždane aktivnosti. Fennelova koma nas u snu uvodi u prošlost u Punu u Indiju 1778. g. Britanska istočnoindijska kompanija zaposjeda palače i mladi kapetan imenom James Steward, izgledom nevjerojatno sličan Fennelu, upravo kreće na opasnu misiju. Putem se susreće s ubojstvima, prijevarama, izdajom i osvetom. Duboko se zaljubljuje u indijsku ratnicu Tulaju i to postaje nemoguća ljubav za koju se mora boriti. Jedino moć prstena može prevazići vrijeme i spasiti život.

programme.title: Djetinjstvo vođe, film
programme.desc: Ova strašna bajka o nastanku autoritarizma u 20. Stoljeću, priča priču o dječaku koji živi u Francuskoj 1918. g. i čiji otac radi za američku vladu na stvaranju Versajskog ugovora. Ono čemu svjedoči, pomaže mu u stvaranju njegovih uvjerenja - a mi svjedočimo rođenju strašnog ega. Nadahnuto iskustvima iz ranog djetinjstva mnogih velikih diktatora 20. stoljeća te obiluje grozom, poput filma ‘Others and The Omen’, kao zlokoban prikaz nastajućeg zla.

programme.title: Brahms: Dječak 2, film
programme.desc: Nastavak filma "Dječak" s Katie Holmes u glavnoj ulozi. Radi se o nevjerojatnoj priči o dječaku-lutki koja je šokirala publiku diljem svijeta. Odlično stiliziran, sablastan, neizvjestan i prilično uznemirujući horor film, kakvog dugo na filmskim platnima nismo gledali. Nakon što se mlada obitelj, nesvjesna njene prošlosti, useli u vilu Heelshire na zabačenom imanju, njihov sin pronalazi novog prijatelja, jezivog lutka kojeg naziva Brahms. Brahms je prilično uznemirujući lutak, kojeg se morate bojati. U njemu stanuje zlo, a u njegovom se domu mora igrati po njegovim pravilima!

programme.title: Iscjelitelj, film
programme.desc: Kad je 9-godišnjem Robu Coleu umrla majka, taj bliski doživljaj smrti odredio je njegov životni put, jer je on bio osjetio da neće preživjeti čim se razboljela. Ostao je siroče i postao pomoćnik putujućem brijaču i iscjelitelju (S. Skarsgard), koji je prenio na njega sve što je znao o puštanju krvi i vađenju zuba. U želji da što više nauči mladić (T. Payne) je napustio Englesku i otputio se u Perziju, jer se tamo, daleko na istoku, u Isfahanu nalaze najbolja škola i bolnica toga doba, a podučava najslavniji liječnik, znanstvenik i filozof Ibn Sina (B. Kingsley), u zapadnom svijetu poznat kao Avicena. U muslimanskom svijetu na studij ne primaju kršćane, ali Rob ne odustaje, preruši se u židova kako bi dobio pristup... Snimljeno prema istoimenom romanu Noaha Gordona.

programme.title: Zaraza iz mora, film
programme.desc: Jedina studentica morske biologije Siobhán mora provesti tjedan dana na ribarici gdje joj neće biti ugodno s već bliskom posadom. Ali iz dubina Atlantskog oceana, nepoznat oblik života zarobi brod. Kad članovi posade počnu pokazivati znakove čudne zaraze, Siobhán mora nadići svoje otuđenje i pridobiti povjerenje posade prije negoli svi umru.

programme.title: Samo da zapjevam, film
programme.desc: Tinejdžerica iz maloga grada tijekom '60-ih vjeruje da će joj se ostvariti njezini snovi da postane slavna pjevačica kad joj u gradić dođe njezin idol, rock zvijezda. No njezin će san postati noćna mora kad se u obližnjem kemijskom postrojenju dogodi nezgoda koja bi mogla prouzrokovati mutacije.

programme.title: Zona katastrofe: Vulkan u New Yorku, film
programme.desc: New York City zahvatili su neobjašnjivi potresi i eksplozije. Matt MacLachlan (Costas Mandylor) i njegov tim u tunelu ugledaju lavu kako ulazi u gradski vodovodni sustav i tako saznaju istinu: tajni eksperiment jednog znanstvenika Leveringa (Michael Ironside) pokrenuo je vulkansku aktivnost. Zajedno s bivšom suprugom geologinjom Susan (Alexandra Paul) i skupinom junaka, Matt će pokušati spasiti grad od vulkanske apokalipse.

programme.title: Colossal, film
programme.desc: Gloria je nezaposlena partijanerica koja je prisiljena napustiti svoj život u New Yorku i vratiti se u rodni grad nakon štu ju dečko izbaci stana. Kad na vijestima osvane ogromno čudovište koje uništava grad Seul u Južnoj Koreji, Gloria postepeno dolazi do spoznaje da je na neki način povezana s tim udaljenim fenomenom. Događaji počinju izmicati kotroli, a Gloria mora utvrditi zašto njeno naizgled beznačajno postojanje ima tako ogroman utjecaj na sudbinu svijeta.

programme.title: Enderova igra, film
programme.desc: U namjeri da istrijebi ljude, rasa izvanzemaljca Formics, opustoši Zemlju. Pedeset godina kasnije, odlučniji nego ikada, ljudi nastoje uzvratiti udarac tehnološki superiornoj rasi napadača. Među talentiranom djecom, koju trenira tzv. Internacionalna flota da postanu zapovjednici, koji će jednog dana voditi u pobjedu, nalazi se povučeni i genijalni kadet Andrew Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield), koji privuče pažnju pukovnika Hyruma Graffa (Harrison Ford) i majorice Gwen Anderson (Viola Davis).

programme.title: Vlak za Busan, film
programme.desc: Dok se nepoznati virus širi cijelom zemljom, Korejske vlasti proglase izvanredno stanje, no situacija ubrzo izmakne kontroli. Nekolicina onih koji su se u tom trenutku našli na brzom vlaku iz Seoula za Busan, gradu koji je se uspješno obranio od virusne epidemije, sada se moraju boriti za vlastiti opstanak ne bi li preživjeli i stigli do željenog cilja prije nego to bude prekasno.

programme.title: Vlak za Busan: Zona zombija, film
programme.desc: Radnja ovog filma nas vraća na korejski poluotok četiri godine nakon što je krenula zombi apokalipsa. Područje na kojem je nekoć bila Koreja sada je potpuno izolirano od ostatka svijeta i stavljena u karantenu te se zombi apokalipsa uspjela lokalizirati samo na tom dijelu svijeta. Nitko ne ide tamo, zombiji ne mogu van, a Jung-seok koji preživljava u Hong Kongu kao sitni kriminalac, dobit će zadatak povratka u opasno područje.

The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Radio waves, born from electromagnetism, power wireless tech like phones, TVs, and RADAR. Though invisible, they've transformed society. Discoveries by Galvani, Franklin, and Oersted revealed their power. From melting chocolate to X-rays, EM waves penetrate everything—even the human body. Now, they're helping us explore the brain. What's next for this invisible force?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Water covers 71% of the Earth's surface and is the medium of life. All life forms and their surrounding ecosystems are dependent upon water, without it we would cease to exist. Director of Notre Dame's Environmental Change Initiative, Dr. David Lodge examines the infestations that are spreading throughout our fresh and salt water systems and clogging our precious waterways.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Team members Patricia Marin and Malinka Franklin help a lost soul cross over into the light.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Life on planet Earth is a fragile enough proposition as it is. The Earth is an interconnected system, everything is dependent on everything else, and we as a species should learn how to avoid making things worse than they need to be. In this rather sobering instalment of Desperate Hours our special focus is on Environmental Disasters. We will explore what has actually been done to protect the environment in contrast to the long discussions on this topic. From polluting the planet in various ways to the effects of global warming we contemplate how our future might be affected. As custodians of the planet, are we not better to be safe, rather than sorry?

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We've got our own private Idaho in Boise. We'll tour one of the most stunning buildings in the frontier west at the Idaho State Capitol, dance all night with the Basques at the Basque museum and cultural center, soar to new heights at the Warhawk Air Museum in Nampa, and get a shiver down our spines at the Idaho state penitentiary.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the Kennedy Space Center located on Florida's famous "Space Coast." We'll speak to NASA engineers about the past, present and future of American space travel, as well as take a look at the attractions KSC has to offer.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Alaska is known for it's Alaskan Pipeline and the best heli-skiing this episode takes us deep into mountain lines as we try to out run avalanches.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A look into the world and culture of snowmobiling; the fans, the lifestyle and the sport.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live

programme.title: Yves Saint Laurent - Fire Starter
programme.desc: A documentary of a true pioneer of fashion. Sabbatical Entertainment celebrates one of the most influential designers ever as we explore the designer's unparalleled professional acclaim, as well as his fascinating and tumultuous personal life. Yves Saint Laurent can be credited with both spurring the couture's rise in the 1960s as well as the tuxedo suit for women. He was able to adapt his style to accommodate the changes in fashion during his entire career. Sabbatical Entertainment's original documentary shows viewers how YSL approached fashion with a different narrative by wanting women to look comfortable yet elegant at the same time.

programme.title: For Our Eyes Only
programme.desc: In "For Our Eyes Only," get to know all the actors who have embodied the super spy: Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, and Daniel Craig, their similarities and characteristics that differentiate each one when exhibiting his well-known charm, class and elegance, combined with physical and mental prowess, that makes 007 a real life super hero.

programme.title: Berber, A Quest For Water
programme.desc: In the remote valleys of the Atlas range in Morocco, lies a village Tizi Anoucheg, where water is a rare resource. Berbers are the only people to be found in this harsh environment. They convert the red and dried valleys into a lush green using ancestral irrigation methods. With climate change threatening their very existence one man rises to the occasion & tries to solve the severe water problem.

programme.title: The World's Greatest Carnivals: Quebec Winter Carnival
programme.desc: This 3D documentary special takes us to one of the most colourful and elaborate celebrations on earth where both human creativity and glorious cultures come together. The Quebec Winter Carnival is the world's largest winter Carnival. It celebrates everything about winter with all sorts of unique competitions and celebrations _ from Canoe races across the St. Lawrence River to horse racing with sleds, dog-sledding, skating, ice sculptures, food, music and fun.

programme.title: Volcanic Planet
programme.desc: Volcanoes are the most extreme, dramatic, and explosive forces of nature on our planet. Volcanoes have produced many of the most valuable minerals _ and most of the arable soil on earth. Every day, they are exploding around the world. When the Yellowstone Super Volcano blows (and it is now 48,000 years overdue to do so), it will destroy most of life on North America. Award-winning filmmaker Peter Rowe has climbed and filmed 19 volcanoes, and tells the story of them, the adventures of climbing them, the people who live beside them, and the scientists who risk their lives to study them, in "Volcanic Planet". He also convinces his climbing partner George Kourounis to get married (!?) on the exploding lip of one of them. Filmed in Congo, Iceland, Italy, Vanuatu, Hawaii, Tonga, Turkey, Guatemala, New Zealand, Costa Rica and under the Pacific Ocean, "Volcanic Planet" is a fast-paced high-voltage tour of the world's most active smoking mountains.

programme.title: The Subversives
programme.desc: Theo van Boven becomes Director of Human Rights for the UN in 1977, where it was impossible to even name a country for gross violations. No bureaucrat, he battles the most repressive regimes of the late 20th century, such as Chile and Argentina and opens the UN door for the first time to "subversive" survivors from across the world. Risking everything, he even takes on the US and the Secretary General.

programme.title: Vacaciones Con Fidel
programme.desc: Tristan is a journalist with deep political convictions who worked for years doing journalistic research. Once married and with three children, he accepts a much more remunerative job on commercial television and gradually becomes involved in a life he did not expect.

programme.title: Survivors Of the Invisible
programme.desc: One million different species of insects live on Earth. Diving into their world is kind of like adventuring to a faraway and unknown galaxy. With one difference: these living creatures do not live light-years away from us but right under our feet! With unique technologies shots developed by an Austrian entomologist, the film Survivors of the Invisible will make you discover the world of insects as you have never seen it before.

programme.title: Fundamentalism: Is There A Way Back
programme.desc: A growing counter-terrorist movement is gaining worldwide momentum.After the attacks in New York, London, Madrid and Bali as well as the assassinations in Toulouse carried out by Mohamed Merah, the world wonders about how these Islamists came to the point they were able to commit such atrocities: to kill in cold blood and be willing to die a Martyr's death. How and why did these young men become radicals? Is it reversible?In a number of countries, deradicalization programs have sprung up. Have they been successful? In this documentary, the first ever of its kind, reporters will meet with some Islamists _ former terrorists _ who have left the path of terror and now dedicate their lives to persuading other terrorists to do the same.

programme.title: Boteti: The Returning River
programme.desc: For 20 years the Boteti River in northern Botswana lay dry, leaving wildlife dependent on a handful of shrinking rain pools. Then, after decades of drought, heavy rains in the Angolan highlands send water flowing once more. Boteti _ The Returning River captures this dramatic rebirth, revealing how animals endured the harsh years and how the river's return transforms the landscape. Filmed over two years in stunning HD, the film documents rare behavior, explosive life, and the renewal of an entire ecosystem.

programme.title: Against the Tide
programme.desc: Albert (21) decides to fight cancer on his own terms while striving to help others around the world going through the same traumatic experience.

programme.title: Under the Lights: Pele
programme.desc: A biography of the greatest player of all time on the pitch and one of the most iconic legends in sport.

programme.title: Isetenkheb's Egyptian Coffin
programme.desc: Follow from the amazing restoration process of one of the most cherished and mysterious pieces of History: an Egyptian sarcophagus covered with hieroglyphics (painted wood). With exclusive interviews of experts, art curators and restorators, discover everything about the story of the Isetenkheb coffin of Ancient Egypt dated from around 664-500 BC!

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we explore Las Vegas' lesser known past. We visit the National Atomic Testing museum to learn about how the desert outside of Vegas was used for testing America's secret nuclear weapons. We also visit the Mormon Fort, the first permanent non-native settlement in the area, as well as the Neon Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: It's island living in the Keys on this episode of TTH. We learn about the islands treasure hunting history at the Mel Fisher Museum. Then we'll explore Fort Jefferson, an isolated fort in the Gulf of Mexico that defended the islands. American literature enthusiasts will enjoy a look at Ernest Hemingway's Key West home, where some of his most famous works were penned.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running Southbound outside on Central Coast with a big Tyee Chinook Release finish North of Milbanke Sound!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city's growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum. We then travel to the nearby Sao Tome Basilica, the church and burial site of St. Thomas the Apostle. In Pondicherry, French influences can still be felt in the tree-lined streets, colonial mansions and cafés. Its beautiful setting on the Bay of Bengal makes Pondicherry a delightful place to spend the day. We also visit the ancient port city of Mahabalipuram, where the landscape is dominated by carved-stone architecture. The final highlight of our tour is the Descent of Ganga, which is the world's largest bas-relief carving.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This ancient ruined city, lost to history, was one of the most powerful in the world during its prime. The architectural sophistication and sheer size will amaze. Then Journeys heads out to the deep ocean for some big game fishing. Will we land the big one or return empty handed?

The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: From the skyscrapers of Shanghai to the mountainous peaks of "The Last Shangri-La", explore the breathtaking landscape of this incredible country and connect with the people that infuse China's everyday life with flavor, passion and prosperity. Through the eyes of a cultural academic, a laborer, an architect, an urban planner, and a photographer, the grand evolution of a little fishing village is illustrated and documented to reveal one of the fastest growing megacities in the world. And while the physical landscape gracefully moves towards the future, beliefs, behaviors, and practices are put into test. The changes brought by the Thirty Year Miracle are indeed immense, and it has left no stone, no life, unturned.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: On the 11th of November, 1918, the First World War drew to an end with a terrible toll… after a conflict unlike anything Humanity had ever seen before. For 4 years and 3 months, soldiers from at least 20 countries were plunged in the hell of trenches… caught under a deluge of bombs.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: This was the \" other \" Second World War _ the one in the Pacific, confronting the Japanese Imperial Army to the Americans. Although not as famous as the war that raged in Europe, this conflict was just as ferocious and central to our collective memory.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: Hitler's downfall began before the official end of the war in 1945. Specifically, on June 22, 1941. Hitler launched the largest military offensive in history _ against the USSR in Operation Barbarossa.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We visit the old south and enjoy some sweet tea in Savannah. On this episode, we'll stroll the city's beautiful squares, as well as visit it's civil war past at Old Fort Jackson. Then, we head up the stairs of the famous Tybee Island lighthouse and visit the Savannah Railroad museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: There's a lot to cover in the oldest city in America. Take a sip from the distinctively tasting Fountain of Youth. Then we'll cross the draw bridge of the undefeated Spanish Fort, the Castillo San Marcos. Then we'll learn the true history of pirates at the Pirate Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling cut plug herring from home base on Denny Island, BC!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow. In the old city, we travel by rickshaw through the narrow streets and discover a world that is quickly disappearing. Then it's on to the tomb of Humayun, whose architectural design inspired one of the Seven Wonders of the World, the great Taj Mahal. We visit 2 mosques that are in the record books: the very first mosque in Delhi and the largest mosque in India. Next we visit the National Gandhi Museum where we view personal items from Gandhi's life, visit a temple that's open to all faiths and complete the quickest tour of India, without leaving Delhi.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the greatest ancient monuments in the world are in South India—Hampi and Konark. These two wonders of the world were lost to the west, but now are at the top of many bucket lists. Join Bill as he takes the veil off these two incredible achievements of man.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Featured in films and documentaries, the mane-less lions of Tsavo have a fierce reputation _ man-eaters. Journeys embarks on a photo hunt for these legendary beasts of the bush. In the process, we witness the raw power of the ghosts in the dark.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Once a year in good rain years, the deserts of South Africa explode in color. This is the greatest flower bloom in the world. We venture into the desert to experience this first-hand and film the rare animals that call this arid land home.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Shark Business unravels some of the mysteries surrounding sharks with controversial behaviorist Dr. Erich Ritter. You'll witness divers testing the limits of shark-human interaction outside of cages with dangerous sharks such as lemon, bull and even great white sharks! Recount the events that led to the attack that almost killed Dr. Ritter. Witness a feeding Frenzy of over 100 reef sharks in the Bahamas, and see a diver literally ride a Great White Shark in Gansbai, South Africa! This episode has shark action like you have never seen before!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world _ the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster _ North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus _ Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider _ Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web _ Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Wildebeest & Zebra _ Africa's iconic drifters. No two zebra have the same stripes, even in vast herds. Olive Ridley Turtles _ The world's most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern _ These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans _ Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks _ Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies. From camouflage to flight, every adaptation helps insects stay in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Finally for this series, we are exploring the world of nocturnal animals—creatures adapted to thrive in darkness. Escaping predators, avoiding heat, and sharing resources, they emerge as night falls. Join porcupines, raccoons, mice, cats, foxes, and more on their nightly journey. From raccoons with sensitive touch to mice surviving in teams, each is a master of the night. Across continents, these animals—like the fruit-loving porcupine—showcase fear, excitement, and survival in the shadows.

programme.title: S one strane flamenka
programme.desc: Plesni dokumentarac "S one stranke flamenka" u središte stavlja španjolski ples imenom jota. Film prikazuje varijacije u plesu, ovisno u kojem se dijelu Španjolske on pleše. Ni jedan ples nije isti, od onoga u kojem plesače potiče zvuk kastanjeta, do onih u kojima plesače pokreću zvukovi gitara. Flamenko i jota nastale su u otprilike isto vcrijeme, na istom području Španjolske, a to je Andaluzija. U filmu se, kroz arhivske snimke, ujedno prikazuje povijest flamenka te povijest pjesama na temelju kojih je u španjolskom građanskom ratu nastala jota.

programme.title: Nacionalna sigurnost: Priča o Arneu Treholtu
programme.desc: Godine 1985. uhićenje karizmatičnog diplomata i bivšeg državnog tajnika Arnea Treholta šokirao je njegovu rodnu Norvešku. Osuđen na 20 godina zatvora zbog špijunaže za Sovjetski Savez i Irak, Treholt i dalje poriče sve optužbe do današnjeg dana. Proveo je devet godina u strogo čuvanom zatvoru, do puštanja na slobodu početkom 90-ih, nakon što ga je pomilovala norveška vlada. S ekskluzivnim pristupom Treholtu, onima koji su bliski skandalu i stručnjacima za međunarodnu špijunažu, ovaj šestodijelni dokumentarac snimljen u New Yorku, Norveškoj i Rusiji priča fascinantnu priču o tome kako je uglednu javnu osobu s glamuroznom suprugom zavela ruska obavještajna služba.

programme.title: Blago koje su ukrali Britanci
programme.desc: Utemeljena na podcastu, „Blago koje su ukrali Britanci (Stuff The British Stole) je dokumentarna serija koja otkriva povijest Britanskog Carstva. U svakoj epizodi, nagrađeni novinar Marc Fennell odabire ukradeni predmet i vodi vas na globalnu avanturu kroz divlju, zabavnu i vizualno zapanjujuću priču o tome kako je ukradeni predmet dospio do mjesta na kojem se danas nalazi i tko to želi natrag. Marc Fennell će otkriti globalne priče o pogrešnim pljačkama, ratovima, spletkama, junaštvu i preživljavanju. Naposljetku, ovo nije serija o prošlosti, već o razumijevanju današnjeg svijeta. Čak i ako mislite da znate ovu priču, ova serija dokazuje da je povijest sve samo ne jasna.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Danny iz Lincolnshirea svojoj djeci gradi elegantnu, ali cjenovno pristupačnu kuću na stupovima među stablima u vrtu njihove prizemnice. Ambiciozan je, ali neiskusan, a njegov budžet ne odgovara izazovima koje mu projekt donosi.

programme.title: Bog je žena
programme.desc: Domorodački narod Kuna u Panami tvrdi da su oni pravi vlasnici dokumentarca o njima iz 1975., koji im nikada nije pokazan. Nakon pola stoljeća, društvo u kojemu su žene svete, konačno dobiva svoje snimke.

programme.title: Velika obalna putovanja željeznicom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo istražuje obalu sve četiri nacije Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, od škotskog gorja Highlands koje oduzima dah do Isle of Wight, preko poluotoka Lizard u Cornwallu do pješčanog sjevernog Walesa. Putem upoznajemo lokalno stanovništvo i otkrivamo strast i ponos na njihovu povijest, kulturu i identitet, te istražujemo izazove s kojima se ove regije danas suočavaju.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Druga šansa
programme.desc: Dokumentarac o Richard Davisu, izumitelju moderne pancirke, koji je pucao u sebe najmanje 192 puta kako bi dokazao da njegov proizvod uistinu radi. Pokrenuo je Second Chance, koja je postala najveća tvrtka za prsluke na svijetu, spasivši više od 3000 života.

programme.title: Gogo
programme.desc: Priscilla Sitieni Gogo živi u srcu doline Rift u sjeverozapadnoj Keniji. Ima 94 godine i najstarija je školarka u osnovnoj školi koju pohađa. Akademska godina u selu Ndalat bit će uistinu posebna. U svojoj posljednjoj godini osnovne škole, Gogo želi postići svoj životni cilj: položiti sve ispite i zaraditi diplomu. U tom pothvatu ohrabruju je Myriam i Tracy, njezini 54-godišnji praunuci te ujedno i cijela škola. Hoće li uspjeti?

programme.title: Blago koje su ukrali Britanci
programme.desc: Utemeljena na podcastu, „Blago koje su ukrali Britanci (Stuff The British Stole) je dokumentarna serija koja otkriva povijest Britanskog Carstva. U svakoj epizodi, nagrađeni novinar Marc Fennell odabire ukradeni predmet i vodi vas na globalnu avanturu kroz divlju, zabavnu i vizualno zapanjujuću priču o tome kako je ukradeni predmet dospio do mjesta na kojem se danas nalazi i tko to želi natrag. Marc Fennell će otkriti globalne priče o pogrešnim pljačkama, ratovima, spletkama, junaštvu i preživljavanju. Naposljetku, ovo nije serija o prošlosti, već o razumijevanju današnjeg svijeta. Čak i ako mislite da znate ovu priču, ova serija dokazuje da je povijest sve samo ne jasna.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Prije deset godina Jon i Noreen namjeravali su izgraditi kuću na stablu na zemljištu u Jonovu rodnom gradu u Gloucestershireu. Kuća je bila jedva nastanjiva kad su se 2016. u nju uselili. Nakon sedam godina Kevin se vraća da bi doznao kako izgleda život na stablu.

programme.title: Posljednja oaza
programme.desc: Voda. Najdragocjeniji izvor planete Zemlje. Ona pokreće naše gradove, nebrojene industrije ovisne su o njoj, a sva živa bića trebaju je za preživljavanje. Međutim, vrlo je izvjesno da u bližoj budućnosti neće biti dovoljno vode da održi život na našoj planeti. Globalna kriza s vodom biti će svjetski problem br. 1 ovog stoljeća. Uz malo truda s tim problemom možemo izaći na kraj, ali samo ako odlučimo djelovati odmah. „Posljednja oaza moćan je dokumentarni film koji uzdrmava mit o našem najdragocjenijem izvoru.

programme.title: Druga šansa
programme.desc: Dokumentarac o Richard Davisu, izumitelju moderne pancirke, koji je pucao u sebe najmanje 192 puta kako bi dokazao da njegov proizvod uistinu radi. Pokrenuo je Second Chance, koja je postala najveća tvrtka za prsluke na svijetu, spasivši više od 3000 života.

programme.title: Druga šansa
programme.desc: Dokumentarac o Richard Davisu, izumitelju moderne pancirke, koji je pucao u sebe najmanje 192 puta kako bi dokazao da njegov proizvod uistinu radi. Pokrenuo je Second Chance, koja je postala najveća tvrtka za prsluke na svijetu, spasivši više od 3000 života.

programme.title: Velika obalna putovanja željeznicom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo istražuje obalu sve četiri nacije Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, od škotskog gorja Highlands koje oduzima dah do Isle of Wight, preko poluotoka Lizard u Cornwallu do pješčanog sjevernog Walesa. Putem upoznajemo lokalno stanovništvo i otkrivamo strast i ponos na njihovu povijest, kulturu i identitet, te istražujemo izazove s kojima se ove regije danas suočavaju.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Gogo
programme.desc: Priscilla Sitieni Gogo živi u srcu doline Rift u sjeverozapadnoj Keniji. Ima 94 godine i najstarija je školarka u osnovnoj školi koju pohađa. Akademska godina u selu Ndalat bit će uistinu posebna. U svojoj posljednjoj godini osnovne škole, Gogo želi postići svoj životni cilj: položiti sve ispite i zaraditi diplomu. U tom pothvatu ohrabruju je Myriam i Tracy, njezini 54-godišnji praunuci te ujedno i cijela škola. Hoće li uspjeti?

programme.title: Nacionalna sigurnost: Priča o Arneu Treholtu
programme.desc: Godine 1985. uhićenje karizmatičnog diplomata i bivšeg državnog tajnika Arnea Treholta šokirao je njegovu rodnu Norvešku. Osuđen na 20 godina zatvora zbog špijunaže za Sovjetski Savez i Irak, Treholt i dalje poriče sve optužbe do današnjeg dana. Proveo je devet godina u strogo čuvanom zatvoru, do puštanja na slobodu početkom 90-ih, nakon što ga je pomilovala norveška vlada. S ekskluzivnim pristupom Treholtu, onima koji su bliski skandalu i stručnjacima za međunarodnu špijunažu, ovaj šestodijelni dokumentarac snimljen u New Yorku, Norveškoj i Rusiji priča fascinantnu priču o tome kako je uglednu javnu osobu s glamuroznom suprugom zavela ruska obavještajna služba.

programme.title: Zuckerberg: Kralj metaverzuma
programme.desc: U siječnju 2004. student s Harvarda Mark Zuckerberg pokrenuo je društvenu mrežu Facebook koja danas povezuje gotovo polovicu svjetske populacije. Ovaj zadivljujući dokumentarac istražuje izvanredan uspon i utjecaj Facebooka; kako je pomogao osnažiti Arapsko proljeće 2010., ali je također navodno potaknuo dezinformacije koje su doprinijele usponu Trumpa i genocidu u Mianmaru. Ujedno, film istražuje što nezaustavljiv uspon metaverzuma znači za moć, privatnost i nepovjerenje diljem svijeta i svih naših života.

programme.title: Toshack
programme.desc: Izvanredna priča i bajkoviti uspon Swansea Cityja pod Johnom Toshackom. Tosh se 1978. pridružio Swansima na dnu 4. lige, a do proljeća 1982. bili su na vrhuncu 1. lige.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Graeme i Melanie žele da njihov novi dom u Hackneyju odaje počast njihovoj spojenoj obitelji. Međutim, ispostavilo se da će to biti teže nego što su mislili: crvena kuća s dubokim podrumom koju je arhitekt Graeme projektirao jedva staje na njihovu malenu parcelu.

programme.title: Igranje vatrom
programme.desc: Nominiran za nagradu Oscar, ovaj dokumentarac prikazuje nevjerojatnu i inspirativnu priču o grupi žena iz najniže kaste indijske društvene hijerarhije koje protivno svim izgledima vode vlastitu medijsku organizaciju i izdaju novine. Naoružane olovkama i pametnim telefonima, one su u konstantnoj potrazi za pričama koje će dati glas najranjivijim članovima njihovog društva. Novi novinari brzo se treniraju i odmah šalju na teren, a čitaju ih milijuni unatoč njihovom niskom društvenom statusu. Ovaj fascinantan dokumentarni film osvojio je nagrade praktički svugdje gdje se prikazao, od međunarodnog dokumentarnog filmskog festivala Al-Jazeera pa sve to filmskog festivala u Belfastu, a njegova atraktivnost još je i veća zbog objave da će novinarke koje se bore za slobodu govora biti nagrađene Nobelovom nagradom za mir.

programme.title: Kim's Video - Kultna videoteka
programme.desc: Kronika nevjerojatne priče njujorške videoteke koja je inspirirala generaciju za generacijom ljubitelja filma, skupivši na svojim policama fimove svih žanrova i redatelja te kako je potpuno neočekivano, odjednom zatvorila svoja vrata te naizgled nestala, kako se jedan dan u svojoj cijelosti njena filmska arhiva pojavila u smalom selu na Siciliji, te koje tajne je ponijela sa sobom.

programme.title: Ja sam Raquel Welch
programme.desc: „Ja sam Raquel Welch je igrani dokumentarac koji slavi život glumice i samohrane majke, koja ne samo da je redefinirala ideju holivudskog ‘seks simbola’, već je i promovirala suvremene akcijske heroine. Od trenutka kada je postala zvijezda filmom „One Million Years B.C., uslijedile su uloge u filmovima „100 pušaka, „Myra Breckinridge i „Hannie Caulder, da bi osvojila Zlatni globus za ulogu u filmu Tri mušketira. U pozadini nevjerojatno burnih vremena u Americi, ona je iskoristila svoju zapanjujuću ljepotu, jedinstvenu osobnost i talent kako bi postala ikona Hollywooda i šire.

programme.title: Ghislaine: Partnerica u zločinu
programme.desc: Dramatičan rasplet suđenja Ghislaine Maxwell zaokupio je naslovnice diljem svijeta svojim šokantnim detaljima, razotkrivajući tajnoviti svijet elite superbogatih. U ovom dokumentarcu otkriva se istina o osramoćenoj bivšoj članici društvene elite, uključujući njezine veze s Jeffreyjem Epsteinom i princom Andrewom, te istragu FBI-a koja je rezultirala njezinom 20-godišnjom zatvorskom kaznom. Kroz izvanredne uvide, eksplozivne nove informacije i pedantno istraživanje, ovaj ključni prikaz nas vodi unutar priče. S ekskluzivnim pristupom nikad prije viđenom arhivskom materijalu i originalnim intervjuima s ključnim svjedocima - uključujući članove obitelji i prijatelje, od kojih mnogi govore po prvi put - Ghislaine: Partnerica u zločinu je uvjerljiv, zadivljujuć za gledanje.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Tesarica Lucinda sa sinom Danom i kćeri Rosie gradi drvenu kuću u šumarku iznad njihova obiteljskog doma. Za projekt je izdvojila tek 150 000 £. Budući da ne žele oštetiti korijenje stabala, moraju smisliti način da dopreme materijal do gradilišta bez uporabe teških strojeva.

programme.title: Nossa Chape
programme.desc: „Nossa Chape dokumentarac je koji prati brazilski nogometni klub Chapecoense nakon stravične zrakoplovne nesreće koja se dogodila 28. studenog 2016. godine, a u kojoj su, osim trojice, poginuli gotovo svi igrači kluba. Uz ekskluzivan pristup novoj momčadi, obiteljima poginulih i trojici preživjelih igrača, ovaj dokumentarni film prikazuje podjelu kluba, ali i samog grada u vezi posljedica tragedije: trebaju li se fokusirati na to da sjećanje na poginule održe živim ili nastaviti dalje s vlastitim životima? Međutim, dok se cijela momčad priprema za novi let istom, tragičnom rutom kako bi odigrali finale prvenstvene utakmice koju je godinu dana prije toga trebala odigrati stara ekipa, svi oni moraju se ujediniti u zajednički cilj.

programme.title: Kim's Video - Kultna videoteka
programme.desc: Kronika nevjerojatne priče njujorške videoteke koja je inspirirala generaciju za generacijom ljubitelja filma, skupivši na svojim policama fimove svih žanrova i redatelja te kako je potpuno neočekivano, odjednom zatvorila svoja vrata te naizgled nestala, kako se jedan dan u svojoj cijelosti njena filmska arhiva pojavila u smalom selu na Siciliji, te koje tajne je ponijela sa sobom.

programme.title: Kim's Video - Kultna videoteka
programme.desc: Kronika nevjerojatne priče njujorške videoteke koja je inspirirala generaciju za generacijom ljubitelja filma, skupivši na svojim policama fimove svih žanrova i redatelja te kako je potpuno neočekivano, odjednom zatvorila svoja vrata te naizgled nestala, kako se jedan dan u svojoj cijelosti njena filmska arhiva pojavila u smalom selu na Siciliji, te koje tajne je ponijela sa sobom.

programme.title: Velika obalna putovanja željeznicom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo istražuje obalu sve četiri nacije Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, od škotskog gorja Highlands koje oduzima dah do Isle of Wight, preko poluotoka Lizard u Cornwallu do pješčanog sjevernog Walesa. Putem upoznajemo lokalno stanovništvo i otkrivamo strast i ponos na njihovu povijest, kulturu i identitet, te istražujemo izazove s kojima se ove regije danas suočavaju.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Tragičan let: Šoreham
programme.desc: Kada se mlazni lovac srušio na prometni glavni put tokom aeromitinga u Šorehamu, ubivši pri tom 11 ljudi i povredivši mnogo više, nacija je ostala užasnuta, a životi onih koji su bili uključeni u ovu nesreću bili su zauvek promenjeni. Ali pad je bio samo početak priče. Nekim čudom pilot je preživeo, i ubrzo se postavilo pitanje da li je za nesreću krivo njegovo pilotiranje. Koristeći šokantne snimke koje su snimili gledaoci, kao i one sa samog mesta nesreće, ova priča govori o katastrofi, njenim posledicama i porodicama žrtava koje se bore za pravdu i istinu.

programme.title: Voleti Patrišu Hajsmit
programme.desc: Film "Ljubavi Patriše Hajsmit" švajcarske rediteljke Eve Vitije zasnovan je na nedavno objavljenim dnevnicima Patriše Hajsmit, kraljice psihološkog trilera i važne figure u kvir istoriji. Film je bio premijerno prikazan u hrvatskim bioskopima 18. decembra 2025. Film se fokusira na njenu potragu za sopstvenim identitetom i turbulentan ljubavni život, a ujedno baca novo svetlo na njeno pisanje. Ekskluzivni arhivski materijal, uz glasove porodice, prijatelja i same autorke, otkriva do sada nepoznato lice jedne od najekranizovanijih spisateljica svih vremena, čiji su predlošci poslužili za kultne filmove "Stranac iz Nord Ekspresa" (r. Alfred Hičkok), "Talentovani gospodin Ripli" (r. Entoni Migela) i "Karol" (r. Tod Hejns).

programme.title: Istorija kletvi
programme.desc: Ne morate verovati, ali trebate biti oprezni... Razotkrivajući istorije i legende koje su pokrenule val nesreća u svetu, ove priče o intrigama, sramu i prevarama su toliko tragične da se i dalje pričaju o zloslutnim silama koje okružuju proklete. Saznajte kako jedan pogrešan korak može izazvati talas patnje. Od Tutankamonove grobnice do Hopeovog dijamanta i Izgubljenog grada Frenier, istorija je prožeta ljudima, mestima i predmetima koji su širili potpuno zli, neukrotivi kaos koji je doneo smrt, katastrofu i destrukciju. Kako su ta prokletstva nastala? Čija je srdžba odgovorna? Koja je istina iza nesretnika? I može li iko ikada da se nada da će to kontrolisati?

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. Privlači gledaoce iznenađujućim činjenicama, brzim kvizovima i zanimljivim mišljenjima. "Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. programme.title: Crvena senka nad Belom kućom
programme.desc: Dok Donald Tramp upravo odnosi pobedu na predsedničkim izborima u Sjedinjenim Državama, ruski uticaj na američku desnicu — putem špijuna, polušpijuna i agenata uticaja — postaje sveprisutna stvarnost, koja do sada nikada nije bila zaista proučena. Ovaj istraživački dokumentarac, snimljen poput političkog trilera i ispričan kao špijunska priča, uvodi nas u priču o ruskoj infiltraciji u Sjedinjene Države, prikazujući mafijašku logiku ruskog sistema, evoluciju putinizma, ambicije ruskog predsednika i njegovu žeđ za osvetom.

programme.title: Grad naturista
programme.desc: Naturističko selo Kap d'Agd ima ozloglašenu reputaciju; mediji ga uporno predstavljaju kao mesto neobuzdanih užitaka _ magnet za svingere iz celog sveta. Od skromnog naturističkog kampa braće Oltra iz pedesetih godina prošlog veka do današnjeg naselja _ raja za libertince _ ovde se odigrala nezapamćena transformacija. Ne zadržavajući se samo na podeli između naturista i libertinaca, ovaj dokumentarni film osvetljava istoriju ovog mesta i sile koje su oblikovale njegov razvoj. Film nam pomaže da razumemo ljude koji ovde borave _ bilo na jedan dan, jednu noć, nedelju dana, tokom odmora ili tokom cele godine. Naturističko selo? Libertinsko selo? Pakao? Raj? Ipak, postoji jedna reč oko koje se ovde svi slažu: sloboda.

programme.title: Dale: pod maskom
programme.desc: Početkom 1990-ih, Vašington D.C. bio je najsmrtonosniji grad u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama. Kriminal je cvetao, a bande su vodile krvavi rat za kontrolu nad trgovinom drogom. Kako bi razbila ove kriminalne grupe, policija Vašingtona formirala je specijalne jedinice tajnih agenata. Dejli Saterlend, policajac i pastor, bio je jedan od tih agenata. Više od 20 godina Dejli je vodio dvostruki život — danju je držao biblijske studije, a noću radio na tajnom zadatku unutar ilegalnih mreža. Majstor veštine infiltracije, snimao je kriminalce bez njihovog znanja, koristeći brojne lažne identitete: italijanskog mafijaša, makroa, dilera droge, producenta rep muzike. Zasnovana na stotinama sati video-snimaka koje je sam Dejli zabeležio usred svojih operacija, kao i na njegovom ličnom svedočenju, ova dokumentarna serija nudi dubinski uvid u kriminalno podzemlje Vašingtona devedesetih godina.
